title: IHE Pharmacy Medication Overview
desc: Preview release - for initial assessment and feedback.

introduction: Preview release of the IHE Pharmacy Medication Overview (MEOW) Implementation Guide, published to advance work on the topic and to collect input from implementers and the community. Content is incomplete and subject to change; this is not a draft for formal ballot.
